gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: The two founders hit it ___ immediately.
gaps.explanation: hit it off = like each other and become friendly quickly.

gaps.sentence: Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
I can't figure ___ how this app works.
They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).
